---
title: "00_split_data"
output: html_document
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
INPUT_FOLDER <- "Raw Data New"
OUTPUT_FOLDER <- "Split Data"

MAX_SIZE_MB <- 49
MAX_SIZE_BYTES <- MAX_SIZE_MB * 1024^2

if (!dir.exists(OUTPUT_FOLDER)) {
  dir.create(OUTPUT_FOLDER)
}

months <- c(
  "january", "february", "march", "april",
  "may", "june", "july", "august",
  "september", "october", "november", "december"
)

month_abbreviations <- c(
  "jan", "feb", "mar", "apr", "may", "jun",
  "jul", "aug", "sep", "oct", "nov", "dec"
)

for (i in seq_along(months)) {

  month <- months[i]
  month_label <- month_abbreviations[i]

  input_file <- file.path(
    INPUT_FOLDER,
    paste0(month, ".csv")
  )

  if (!file.exists(input_file)) {
    cat("File not found:", input_file, "\n")
    next
  }

  original_size <- file.info(input_file)$size
  original_size_mb <- original_size / 1024^2

  cat("\nProcessing:", month, "\n")
  cat("Original size:", round(original_size_mb, 2), "MB\n")

  # Keep original file if below 50 MB
  if (original_size < 50 * 1024^2) {

    output_file <- file.path(
      OUTPUT_FOLDER,
      paste0(month_label, "_2025.csv")
    )

    file.copy(input_file, output_file, overwrite = TRUE)

    cat("File is below 50 MB. No splitting required.\n")
    next
  }

  # Read oversized CSV
  lines <- readLines(input_file, warn = FALSE)

  header <- lines[1]
  data_lines <- lines[-1]

  if (length(data_lines) == 0) {
    stop("No data rows found in: ", input_file)
  }

  # Calculate approximate bytes per row
  row_sizes <- nchar(data_lines, type = "bytes") + 1

  part <- 1
  start_row <- 1

  while (start_row <= length(data_lines)) {

    output_file <- file.path(
      OUTPUT_FOLDER,
      paste0(month_label, "_part", part, ".csv")
    )

    current_size <- nchar(header, type = "bytes") + 1
    end_row <- start_row - 1

    while (end_row < length(data_lines)) {

      next_size <- row_sizes[end_row + 1]

      if (current_size + next_size > MAX_SIZE_BYTES) {
        break
      }

      current_size <- current_size + next_size
      end_row <- end_row + 1
    }

    if (end_row < start_row) {
      stop("A single row exceeds the file size limit.")
    }

    output_lines <- c(
      header,
      data_lines[start_row:end_row]
    )

    writeLines(
      output_lines,
      output_file,
      useBytes = TRUE
    )

    actual_size <- file.info(output_file)$size
    actual_size_mb <- actual_size / 1024^2

    if (actual_size >= 50 * 1024^2) {
      stop("Output file exceeds 50 MB: ", output_file)
    }

    cat(
      basename(output_file),
      "-",
      round(actual_size_mb, 2),
      "MB | Rows:",
      end_row - start_row + 1,
      "\n"
    )

    start_row <- end_row + 1
    part <- part + 1
  }
}

cat("\nAll monthly files processed.\n")
```
